summary: Cold codegen of chemical_detector: two controllers (GasAnalysisController, MovementController) wired by ChemicalDetectorSystem; all 81 requirements traced. Twelve points need human review: invented constant values and mappings, two ambiguous function specs, and the design of the two terminal modes.

issues.title: Terminal modes have a self-loop instead of a Final state
issues.raw: CD-GA-Beh6 says gas analysis 'concludes its search, processing no further readings'; CD-MV-Beh9 says Movement 'stays halted' in Found. The codegen rules require every mode to have an outgoing transition.
issues.fix_directive: Gas analysis ends in mode Concluded, whose only transition is a self-loop on gas that stores the reading in gs (CD-GA-Var1) without analysing it. Found's only transition is a self-loop on obstacle that records l (CD-MV-Var4) without moving or re-emitting flag. Confirm this matches the intent of 'concludes' / 'stays halted'.

issues.title: Constant values are placeholders
issues.raw: CD-Const1..6 say the values are configured at startup but give none.
issues.fix_directive: THR=1.0, LV=1.0, EVADE_TIME=1, STUCK_PERIOD=1, STUCK_DIST=1.0, OUT_PERIOD=1 (durations in abstract Clock units). They are small integers so model checking can reach both sides of every guard. Replace them with deployment values.

issues.title: Sensor position to Angle mapping (angle(x)) is unspecified
issues.raw: CD-Fn3 uses angle(x) and CD-DM7 says list position maps to a sensing direction, but the mapping is never given.
issues.fix_directive: Position x (1-based) maps to Angle.values()[(x-1) % 4], i.e. 1=Left, 2=Right, 3=Back, 4=Front. On a tie, the first sensor with the peak intensity wins.

issues.title: What 'indicates the target chemical' means
issues.raw: CD-Fn1: noGas 'if no reading indicates the target chemical'. No detection floor is given.
issues.fix_directive: analysis returns gasD iff some sample has c equal to the configured target Chem and i > 0.

issues.title: intensity/location range over every chemical, not only the target
issues.raw: CD-Fn2's postcondition bounds every i field in the input, so the peak may belong to a non-target chemical. That peak then drives both the stop decision (CD-GA-Beh6) and the homing direction (CD-GA-Beh7).
issues.fix_directive: Implemented literally, as a max over all samples. Confirm whether only the target chemical's samples should count.

issues.title: GasSensor record named GasSample
issues.raw: CD-DM6 names the record GasSensor. CLAUDE.md says the extractor treats a class or record whose name contains 'sensor' as the sensor record.
issues.fix_directive: Named GasSample(Chem c, double i) so the data type is not taken for the sensor service. The fields match the spec.

issues.title: Representation of Intensity and Chem
issues.raw: CD-DM4 says Chem is opaque; CD-DM5 says Intensity is totally ordered.
issues.fix_directive: Intensity is a double (@RoboChartType real), so thr can be a numeric constant and is compared through goreq. Chem is record Chem(int id), which gives value equality without inventing species names.

issues.title: Operations are Vehicle methods; there are no compute() operation classes
issues.raw: CD-OP1..3 are Vehicle platform operations. The README calls CD-OP4 changeDirection a local operation. None of the four is a sensor-derived computation, which is what the compute() operation-class pattern is for.
issues.fix_directive: move, randomWalk, shortRandomWalk and changeDirection are all Vehicle methods. changeDirection maps left->Right, right->Left and front->Back at LV.

issues.title: Odometer is read as a sensor value, not received as an event
issues.raw: CD-Evt3 lists odometer as an event but describes it only as a distance that is sampled into d0/d1.
issues.fix_directive: Sensor.odometer() returns the latest distance (updated by the platform through updateOdometer). d0 and d1 are assigned from it.

issues.title: How 'during' and 'wait' are realised
issues.raw: CD-MV-FR1 gives Waiting a during action randomWalk(). CD-MV-FR4 and FR7 wait evadeTime and outPeriod.
issues.fix_directive: randomWalk() runs at the head of the Waiting block, i.e. on every cycle spent in Waiting. The waits are Vehicle.pause(n), which records the request; the Java step() does not block.

issues.title: Complementary guards on the condition-only transitions
issues.raw: Analysis, GasDetected and AvoidingAgain leave only through condition-only transitions.
issues.fix_directive: The guards are written as exact complements: stsIsNoGas / !stsIsNoGas, insAtOrAboveThr / !insAtOrAboveThr, and (withinStuckPeriod || advancedBeyondStuckDist) / (!withinStuckPeriod && !advancedBeyondStuckDist). One of them always holds. With a two-valued Status, !stsIsNoGas is equivalent to sts == gasD.

issues.title: System wiring and the NoEvent marker go beyond the spec
issues.raw: The spec defines the two subsystems but not how they are driven. Autonomous transitions need a step() call on cycles with no event.
issues.fix_directive: ChemicalDetectorSystem.cycle(event) steps gas analysis, then movement, then passes each turn/stop/resume from gas analysis to movement. InputEvent.NoEvent is passed on cycles with no Vehicle event. In Java, an event movement cannot take in AvoidingAgain (e.g. turn) is consumed and lost, whereas the RoboChart model would block it. AvoidingAgain lasts one cycle.

next_step: Run the pipeline (compile -> coverage -> preflight -> T2M -> M2M -> M2T -> verifiers) and fix Java against the first failing phase.
